Since 1952, the Sight & Sound cabal of critics summons itself every decade to dictate global taste. 1,639 critics participated in 2022 to remind you that your favorite movie is trash.
Added in 1992, the directors' separate poll proves that filmmakers completely disagree with critics. 480 directors voted in 2022 to elevate their own cinematic kayfabe above journalists.
Audience polls repeatedly vote for Star Wars or The Godfather. The masses demand the myth they have already purchased.
National polls exist primarily to validate local funding. Every nation has a mathematically proven greatest film that no one outside its borders has ever seen.
Topped the Sight & Sound poll for five consecutive decades (1962–2002). 46 critics in 2002 maintained the ultimate kayfabe that a movie about a newspaper tycoon is the peak of human art.
Dethroned the Kane dog in 2012 when 191 critics decided Alfred Hitchcock's Vertigo—a film literally about obsession and heights—was the new objective truth.
Jeanne Dielman conquered the 2022 Sight & Sound critics' poll, weaponizing three hours of real-time kitchen chores to obliterate capitalist entertainment metrics.
Topped the very first Sight & Sound poll in 1952 with a mere 25 more ballots. Neorealism proved that true cinematic power comes from making the audience feel terrible about post-war poverty.
2001: A Space Odyssey topped the 2022 directors poll. Filmmakers united to decree that a slow-moving dialogue-free void is the pinnacle of the moving image.
Yasujiro Ozu's Tokyo Story topped the Directors' poll with 48 votes. The ultimate kayfabe that domestic perfection is achieved by placing a camera two feet off the floor and not moving it.
Seven Samurai (1954) was voted the greatest foreign-language film in a 2018 BBC poll of 209 critics. The foundation myth of every modern action ensemble, extracted from Japanese history.
Fellini's 8½ topped the 2015 LodZ poll of 279 Polish film professionals. Directors love nothing more than watching a film about how incredibly hard it is to be a director.
Gone with the Wind was voted the favorite film of Americans in 2008 and 2014 Harris Interactive polls. The ultimate ending myth of the American public, immune to critical re-evaluation.
The Godfather was voted #1 by Entertainment Weekly, Time Out, and 10,000 Empire readers. The undisputed heavyweight champion of masculine fantasy projection.
The Empire Strikes Back was voted the best film of all time by over 250,000 Empire magazine readers. The kayfabe that sequel IP ownership is the highest art form.
Titanic was voted the greatest hit of all time by 6,000 Chinese movie fans in a 2008 China Daily poll. A global phenomenon built on the extraction of pure teenage emotional labor.
The Exorcist was voted the best horror film by 150 experts in a 2012 Time Out poll. Weaponized Catholic guilt proven to be the most effective mechanism for cinematic terror.
Voted the best action film by Time Out New York and the greatest Christmas movie by Empire readers. The myth that an everyman can defeat European terrorists with no shoes on.
Some Like It Hot was voted the best comedy in a poll of 253 global critics by the BBC in 2017. A masterpiece of cross-dressing survival kayfabe.
Pinocchio was voted the best animated movie by Time Out in 2014. The animation industry's foundational kayfabe: extracting soul from graphite and ink.
Voted the best French film by Time Out Paris and the best European film by Cinemateca Portuguesa. Jean Renoir's ultimate exposé of upper-class societal kayfabe.
Tied for best European film in the 1994 Cinemateca Portuguesa. An illegal rip-off of Dracula that survived by sheer, unadulterated visual trauma.
Battleship Potemkin topped the 1951 Brussels World's Fair poll. Eisenstein's kayfabe: inventing modern editing just to legitimize a state revolution.
Man with a Movie Camera topped the 2014 Sight & Sound documentary poll. Dziga Vertov's radical assault on the very concept of fictional acting.
Voted best Western film in 1996 Nickel Odeon poll of experts. John Ford's ultimate construction of the American geographic kayfabe.
Blade Runner was voted the best sci-fi film by a panel of 56 scientists in The Guardian (2004). The scientists agreed: corporate dystopian depression is our most likely future.
Brokeback Mountain topped the 2016 Time Out London poll for LGBT+ cinema. A masterclass in weaponizing the mythic masculine western against itself.
Voted the greatest film by Empire readers in 2006. The ultimate cinematic kayfabe: patience and a rock hammer will conquer all systemic injustice.
Topped the British Film Institute's user poll of Top 10 Indian Films in 2002. Satyajit Ray's masterpiece that forced the West to admit cinema existed outside their bubble.
Spring in a Small Town (1948) was ranked #1 by the Hong Kong Film Awards Association in 2005. A subtle, poetic sabotage of grand, noisy historical narratives.
The Housemaid (1960) topped a 2024 poll of 240 critics by the Korean Film Archive. The blueprint for Korean cinema's obsession with violent class warfare.
A Better Tomorrow (1986) was voted the second-best Chinese film ever. John Woo established the kayfabe that true brotherhood requires shooting 500 people in slow-mo.
Memories of Underdevelopment was voted best Latin American film by dn critics in 1999. Tomás Gutiérrez Alea's documentation of the ultimate revolutionary spectator sport.
The Red Light Bandit (1968) was voted the best Brazilian film in a 2011 Filco 3 lista poll. A harsh, nihilistic middle finger to polished cinema aesthetics.
Prisioneros de la tierra (1939) was repeatedly voted the greatest Argentine film by the Museo del Cine. A raw, blazing spotlight exposing the extraction of indigenous labor.
Vámonos con Pancho Villa (1936) was voted the best Mexican film in a 1994 Somos 500 poll. It systematically dismantles the romantic kayfabe of revolutionary war.
Picnic at Hanging Rock was voted the best Australian film in a 1996 poll. The ultimate kayfabe of the Australian Gothic: that the continent simply eats people.
Once Were Warriors was voted the best New Zealand film by a 2014 Fairfax Media poll. A brutal shattering of the picturesque, hobbit-filled New Zealand tourism myth.
Voted the best British film ever in a 1999 BFI poll. Orson Welles stealing a movie with five minutes of screen time and a monologue about the Swiss.
Monty Python and the Holy Grail was voted the best British picture by 7,000 film fans (2004). The absolute pinnacle of unhinged, budget-less cinematic sabotage.
Voted the best Czech film of all time by journalists in 1994 and 1998. The grand kayfabe that medieval brutality is best depicted through avant-garde poetry.
Teddy Bear (1981) was voted the best movie in Poland by 49 experts at 2013 Filmfest PL. Pure satirical venom aimed directly at the daily kayfabe of Communist absurdism.
Voted the best Hungarian film in a 2000 critics' poll. Miklós Jancsó's masterclass in how to extract power through sheer, geometric intimidation.
Come and See was voted the best Belarusian film by 49 experts in 2024. The total, uncompromised destruction of the glorious war movie kayfabe.
The Deer (1974) was voted the best Iranian film in a 2009 poll of 92 critics. A fierce social critique that accidentally predicted and fueled an actual real-world revolution.
The Night of Counting the Years (1969) was voted the best Arab film by 44 film professionals. The mythic clash between surviving the present and honoring the ancient dead.
Giv'at Halfon Eina Ona was voted Favorite Israeli Film by 25,000 web users. An absurdist deconstruction of the hyper-militarized national kayfabe.
Dry Summer (1963) was voted the best Turkish film released between 1923-2013. A neo-realist exposé showing that controlling the water means controlling the myth.
The Phantom Carriage (1921) was rated the best Swedish film by FLM magazine. Extracting morality from the audience by threatening them with the Grim Reaper's Uber service.
The Unknown Soldier (1955) was voted the best Finnish movie by Helsingin Sanomat. The national kayfabe of surviving impossible odds through sheer, miserable grit.
Children of Nature (1991) was voted the best Icelandic film. A rejection of western desire dying in favor of merging with the mythological landscape.
Blinkende lygte was voted best Danish movie to the YouGov public poll. The ultimate proof that true bringers are actually functioning, loveable, dysfunctional sociopaths.

lore: Protopia is the idea that the future is a process of slow, incremental improvement you participate in.
The ability to correct beats the appearance of certainty.
Starting before you are ready produces better results than waiting for a perfect plan.
Continuous small improvement treats work as never finished, compounding into large change.
Reframing a vast problem as a specific, local, finishable task restores the sense that action is possible.
A series of small wins builds momentum and evidence that larger change is possible.
Maintenance and repair are systematically undervalued because they are undramatic.
Small consistent improvements accumulate non-linearly over time, outperforming heroic one-offs.
A deliberate slow exhale activates the parasympathetic system, a fast physiological route from reaction back into thinking.
Reclaiming attention begins with regulating the physical body that carries it.
Brief disengagement and mind-wandering support consolidation, so the empty moment is where understanding forms.
Agency over attention is foundational, making the reclaimed second the smallest unit of freedom.
Real know-how is tacit knowledge, learned by doing and living in practitioners.
Skills and knowledge are sustained and passed on within communities of practice bound by shared doing.
Authority signals like polish and credentials can be inversely related to hands-on competence.
Knowledge held and taught within a community is robust against single points of failure.
Action is far more likely when it is specific and social, converting vague intention into behavior.
Mutual aid is a deep and widespread survival strategy across species, older than money.
The willingness to tolerate an awkward beginning separates groups that form from groups that stay imagined.
Communities that self-organize shared resources thicken over repeated cooperation.
Action only ever occurs in the present, making today the only workable unit of the future.
A completed small action changes the world more than a large intended one.
Taking small concrete actions before motivation arrives reliably lifts mood and agency.
Agency is structurally located in the now; the past is fixed and the future is unreachable.
Humans succeeded as a species through unusual friendliness to non-kin.
Low-stakes contact between groups reliably reduces prejudice.
Social rejection registers in the brain like physical pain—an outdated survival alarm.
Reciprocal strategies that begin by cooperating outperform purely defensive ones.
Intrinsic motivation produces better learning and persistence than reward or fear.
Framing situations as experiments reduces the paralysis of needing a guaranteed outcome.
Treating mistakes as feedback is what allows iteration to converge on what works.
Positive states like curiosity broaden the range of thoughts and actions a person considers.
Keeping a direct record over time counters the distortions of memory and media.
Attending to base rates corrects the overweighting of vivid, alarming cases.
Actively seeking disconfirming evidence separates inquiry from rationalization.
Personal calibrated records outperform remembered impressions and forecasts.
Craftsmanship connects skill, material, and judgment, building a grounded sense of agency.
Absorbing, skill-matched activity produces flow that displaces rumination.
Effortful, slower processes produce deeper learning and satisfaction than frictionless ones.
Capacities are maintained through use, resisting the quiet erosion of disuse.
Change often enters through small, low-resistance points rather than direct confrontation.
Small reversible experiments let you learn what works at low cost before committing.
Small principled noncompliance is a constructive act when declining to cooperate with a broken rule.
A functioning demonstration shifts a debate more than rhetoric does.
Tolerance of ambiguity is a learnable disposition required for protopia.
Giving up the relief of certainty is the discomfort protopia asks you to accept.
Durable improvement is maintained, not achieved once.
The trade protopia offers is the discomfort of ongoing uncertainty in exchange for restored agency.
Showing the seams of a system lets people understand, question, and modify it.
Systems that remain genuinely open to revision are the structural signature of participatory process.
The presence of multiple viable paths signals genuine agency.
Visible imperfection signals an unfinished thing still open to your hand.
Effective change starts from where you already have leverage and access.
Marginal gains, small improvements compounded consistently, produce large results.
Action driven by intrinsic purpose is more durable than action requiring applause.
Agency is recovered by converting the vast question of the future into one workable thing you can do now.

Olde Money is printed. If typed into existence is real, backed by the promises your grandparents will pay it back.

Goldsmith realized only 5% of people ask for gold at once. They learned all the power was belief.
The missing founding. First private U.S. bank before the Constitution. War needed funding before freedom.

I believe that banking institutions are more dangerous to our liberties than standing armies.

I killed the bank and all I got was this weird election and a duel. 1832: the only time in history.

Private meeting on Jekyll Island. Write the banking cartel (1911). The public has to believe this was their idea.
Secret meeting of America’s richest men with fake names. What if private bankers wrote public banking law?
Rockefeller’s father-in-law. The legislative inside man on the train of old money.
Respectfully old, European and wise. If I know central banking and you don’t, trust me, I’m saving you.
I was as secretive, indeed as furtive as any conspirator. Jekyll Island happened.

I am a most unhappy man. I have unwittingly ruined my country by a system of credit.

Bankers designing their regulator: they don't fear audit when you own and called it federal agency.

Founded 1921 by Morgan allies. A factory placing bankers, CIA directors, and politicians into a single globalist hive-mind.
The central bank of central banks in Basel. Private, sovereign entity above the law, coordinating global feudalism in secret.
A worldwide system of financial control, able to dominate the political system of each country. — Carroll Quigley. Absolute control.
They say the crashes they engineer are the explicit justification to expand from G7 to G20, centralizing planetary economic power.
Ron Paul’s grassroots movement terrified the cartel. The Fed fought sunlight like vampires fight mirrors.
From Boston to Wall Street, people got wise to money magic. Once peasants learn accounting, every empire sweats.
A state-owned bank that actually works. It partners local banks, keeps capital in the community, and outperforms the Wall Street casino regularly.
Public banks redirect deposits at the Fed into 2–3% government interest. Public banking cuts parasites, not funding. Mrs. Street smiles.
A local currency backed by human labor. Your +$10 note trades actual people with actual neighbors for actual potatoes.
Armed with graphic design and arrogance, he created millions in mutual credit economic activity. A decentralized money revolution.
A completely decentralized network. No central server, no CEO, hard-capped supply of 21 million. Mathematics > manipulation.
If you trust money to stay power, you trust it to your enemy. If the motion inflation is, it is your own strategy to solve money.
Once the Federal Reserve has fully unraveled for 100 years, the system collapses under disbelief. The illusion requires your belief.
Local action beats politics. Build alternative networks, use sound money, and quietly starve the beast of its hollow compliance.
The next century is a choice: a continuation of feudal debt slavery, or a world of trade, decentralization, and human empowerment.
The final move has always been to hand this myth to people: step into this epistemic sabotage as you stay fluffy. And burn the ledger.
A scale model of tomorrow is easily mistaken for a measurement of it.
The render is an argument dressed as a photograph of something that does not yet exist.
Re-framing the present as merely an obstacle devalues the only time anyone can actually act in.
Awe and scrutiny use different states of mind, and awe is faster.
Recasting complex social problems as neat technical fixes flatters the tool and ignores the politics.
Roadmaps present uncertain futures as scheduled milestones, borrowing the authority of a train timetable.
Breakthroughs said to be a few years away sustain belief precisely by never arriving.
Trading on anticipation is a practice old enough to have a name: vaporware.
The society of the spectacle dictates that the polished image stands in for and outranks the thing itself.
A smooth demo predicts almost nothing about a messy real deployment because it only walks the happy path.
In a charged crowd, social proof makes visible enthusiasm self-reinforcing until the clapping becomes the evidence.
Positive affect at the moment of decision narrows scrutiny—wonder is an excellent place to hide a clause.
Charismatic authority rests on belief in the individual, meaning it asks for faith and resists audit by design.
The halo effect allows genius in one domain to be quietly spent as credibility in another.
A mission framed as advancing humanity immunizes itself from the accountability a narrow promise would face.
Shared identity raises the social cost of doubt and turns scrutiny into something close to betrayal.
Artificial scarcity reads as value, and exclusion reads as quality.
Loss aversion makes people defend their position even when the underlying prospect is poor.
Referral mechanics convert enthusiasm into distribution, making the crowd mistake marketing for sharing.
Tiered access grants small status upgrades that feel like progress while the destination stays exactly as far away.
A perpetual soon exploits hyperbolic discounting by keeping the prize psychologically near while practically distant.
The future self becomes a product, and the present self is cast as a defect to be upgraded away.
Every hour spent anticipating is an hour not lived—an opportunity cost that compounds invisibly.
Sustained belief is maintained by re-committing rather than re-evaluating, avoiding the pain of sunk cost.
Reframing criticism as small-mindedness discredits the questioner without engaging the question.
The modern slur misnames a labor argument about power as an ignorant fear of progress.
The fear of social exclusion is processed like physical pain, making dissent genuinely costly.
Following the relief of cognitive dissonance, former doubters defend the new belief more strongly than those who never doubted.
A hopeful pitch amplifies our natural optimism bias into comfortable, paralyzed inaction.
Treating technological progress as inherently liberating smoothly conceals who actually wins and loses.
Reassurance that progress is automatic reduces the felt need to act; agency becomes optional.
When optimism is detached from action, it functions solely to maintain the status quo.
The mind treats vivid representation as proxy evidence of reality.
Repeated exposure to a single polished fragment makes it feel like a finished system.
The absent record of ordinary operation is always the most important missing document.
When momentum is conveyed through tone rather than metrics, the feeling arrives first and satisfies.
The easiest option steadily wins not because it is best, but because it asks the least.
Skills offloaded to tools erode through disuse—a documented trade of capability for ease.
Frictionlessness has a hidden long-term cost paid in lost ability through disuse atrophy.
When the effortful path is engineered away, a life optimized for comfort loses access to the difficulty that builds skill.
Defining progress as the next product keeps attention on acquisition and off of repair.
Planned obsolescence designs products to be replaced rather than maintained.
Due to hedonic adaptation, each upgrade delivers a brief lift before resetting the wanting.
Loyalty systems convert repeat consumption into identity, masking escalation as belonging.
Continually deferring satisfaction spends the present as a means, never an end.
Attention spent on anticipation is a finite resource drained without return.
The cost of perpetual anticipation is invisible because it is paid in ordinary, un-itemized hours.
Costs disclosed amid positive affect at the close of a pitch receive the least scrutiny.
Hiding the seams of a system hides its workings, leaving users unable to contest what they use.
A presentation that absorbs every objection in advance leaves no opening for genuine inquiry.
When only one route is presented, a manufactured choice is being disguised as an inevitability.
Sufficiently advanced presentation acts like magic, and magic works precisely by hiding the mechanism.
Surfacing the load-bearing ifs a pitch keeps hidden is the core of a pre-mortem audit.
Identifying the single most fragile assumption tells you more than admiring the finished facade ever could.
Many who sell a future are compensated on the promise rather than the delivery; for them, arrival is optional.
A promise is only as sound as its hidden assumptions.

lore: The safety valve. When the game stops being a game.
Go everywhere on the map. Prove to the machine that you have surveyed every inch of your own cage.
Reach the end of the level. Your reward is a slightly harder level.
Find an exit to the level. Spoiler: there is no outside.
Ascend to the top of a tower to fight a guy who could have just met you in the lobby.
Go fast or don’t stop. The illusion of choice, accelerated.
Run away from danger until you reach safety. Safety is cutscene.
Climb up until you reach safety. Gravity is now microaggression.
You cannot pass until the developers finish coding the next zone.
Defeat a challenging monster who exists solely to gatekeep your dopamine.
Kill all the monsters in an area. You are the janitor of death.
Kill many of the same monster. Because repetitive labor is fun when it’s violent.
Retrieve random drops for an NPC. The pinnacle of heroic fetch quests.
Kill everyone on a list of targets, a psychopath’s grocery run.
Kill so many enemies as you can without getting hit. Perfect for your ego.
Defeat the computer who is controlling the game against you. He too always wins.
Defeat another player who is likewise trying to defeat you. Keep the plates spinning and cheer.
Help a weak ally navigate a dangerous area. The ultimate test of your patience.
Save all the allies in distress. A hoarding pathology disguised as altruism.
Survive by not letting the enemy win. Stand in this circle until we say you can leave.
Rescue someone who’s been kidnapped. Again. Try harder next time.
Retrieve one or more NPC coupons. Because we need a reason to send you to the other side.
The classic trade chain: trade a paperclip for a house. Mostly you get scammed.
Deliver a fragile item across the map. Weather, bandits, physics—everything hates you.
Collect three ancient artifacts to open the door. Then another door appears.
Collect all the items or live items. Turning wildlife preservation into a hostage situation.
Herd animals into an area. Because AI pathfinding is a joke we play on you.
Gather a group of NPCs together. Wrangling digital toddlers.
Stuffing living creatures into your infinite backpack. Don’t think about it.
Earn your ally’s favor. Friendship is transactional.
Complete your ally’s personal quest so they don’t betray you at the finale.
Earn your ally’s love. Select dialogue options to achieve affection.
A shiny hat to validate your hundred hours of meaningless grinding.
Solve a puzzle because the ancient architect loved pushing blocks around.
Play a smaller game within the game. Pacing is a myth.
Why save the world when you could be taking photos of frogs?
Reaching the most important objective. Press X to end the simulation.
Do this small task every day for incremental rewards. You will forget why.
Beat the clock. Efficiency is panic wearing a stopwatch.
Don’t be seen. Don’t be heard. Don’t exist convincingly.
Select your personality from the available buttons.
Press X not to die. Narrative tension outsourced to your fingers.
You cannot see the battlefield, only your assumptions.
Actions have consequences. Rarely used, always feared.
Progress is fragile. Memory is selective.
The curve was a lie. Welcome to suffering.
Press A to understand. You will not understand.
Congratulations. You did it. It does not matter.
Sit back and watch. Agency is temporarily revoked for drama.
Freedom without direction becomes wandering.
Skip the journey. Remember nothing.
Progress measured in repetition, not meaning.
The system changes after you learn it.
You are the tester. The system is unfinished.

Dig a hole, support with wood, burn the wood, watch the wall vanish.
Knife fighting in the dark in a space the size of a coffin.
Divide the food by the mouths. If the result is zero, you lose.
The first act of defense is accounting.
Useless mouths are expelled. The besieger won't feed them either.
The arithmetic of defeat. Walls don't matter if you can't lift your sword.
Oil is expensive. Water hurts just fine and you can drink the leftovers.
Sand gets inside the suit and cooks you like a baked potato.
The nastiest dust in history. Do not inhale.
When out of weapons, throw the castle itself.
Not the gap. The rock. Know the difference or die.
Designed to maximize your view and minimize your death.
The invisible death slit. Vertical for bows, cross-shaped for crossbows.
The doorbell that answers with a rock.
Where the VIPs hide when the walls fail. It has its own water.
Seeing the enemy camp layout before they even unpack.
A moving apartment complex of doom. Requires a very flat road.
When this touches your wall, the siege becomes a melee.
The Mongols catapulted the Black Death into Europe. Tactical and accidental apocalypse.
Stationary armies destroy their own environment. The water is now poison.
"Attack now, I'm bored." The cause of most failed assaults.
While humans starve, the rat thrives.
Killing him deletes your WiFi. A universal protocol of war.
Assessing the enemy's morale while pretending to discuss terms.
Works because everyone needs it to work eventually.
Ethics are optional when the granary is empty.
Depth is defense. You break one wall, there are two more.
Physical DRM for the ocean.
The gun that ended the Middle Ages. Fire, cool for an hour, repeat.
Every wall is a question. Gunpowder was the answer.
Militarily unreachable. Logistically isolated.
If you can't climb the wall, raise the ground until you can walk over it.
They built a road for three years to conquer a graveyard.
960 defenders who refused to give the besieger the satisfaction.
Suicide by climbing. One man on a ladder vs. the entire garrison.
Pushing into a gap where the enemy has been waiting for you.
The wall is down, but the ground is fighting you.
Walls can be impenetrable to force, but they are permeable to bribery.
If you resist the assault, you pay with your furniture (and your life).
Mercy is for those who surrender before the ram touches the wall.
The answer to "The wall failed" is always "Build a better wall."
The wall becomes the ground. The ground becomes the city. We forget.

lore: Let's circle back to that. Forever.
The first thing in any system that matters. Everything awful that follows begins with their report.
Piloted by a "young" Vael—which means it's only been alive for a few centuries.
Ossian scouts interpret "survey the system" as "establish the Hegemony's claim by shooting the scenery."
The galaxy's nervous system, crewed by fatalists hauling diplomatic secrets worth more than their lives.
The circulatory system of a dying galaxy. If they stop arriving, the sector is already dead.
Where junior officers learn to juggle combat, politics, and broken engines before they inevitably get court-martialed.
Pure, unadulterated aggression shoved into an undersized hull.
Why fire a torpedo when you can just delete the enemy's bank account from orbit?
A floating geopolitical argument. Too expensive to lose, too massive to hide.
A ship with a kill-count so high it constitutes a distinct gravitational anomaly.
A sovereign community in transit. The ultimate geopolitical headache for every border guard.
Officially, it doesn't exist. Unofficially, it just overthrew your planetary government.
A paradise that everyone wants, resulting in an eternal, bloody stalemate. Only 1,200 exist; 49 caused wars.
Where civilizations dump their working class to breathe heavy metals and build empires.
The galaxy's archaeological record. What killed them is probably still down there waiting for you.
A Mycel biological weapon disguised as agriculture. Unstoppable, inevitable ecology.
A cosmopolitan cesspool where bartenders have better geopolitical intel than four-star admirals.
The world that breaks the physics engine. Careers end here; legends begin here.
A legal dispute maintained for 12,000 years. Peace through mutual bureaucratic exhaustion.
8,400 years ago, the working class struck fear into warlords. The only good thing the Hegemony ever did.
Making civilizational choices with zero precedent. 17 successes, 9 wars, 2 dead crews. High risk of getting eaten.
The fine line between "legitimate recovery" and "state-sponsored piracy."
Years in isolation treating phenomena as data points. They make terrible dinner guests.
Changing the course of history while leaving zero receipts. 60% of all politics is just this.
Because access is a right that force can deny, but cannot legitimate denying.
The charts end here. The win condition is simply coming back alive.
Their final transmissions are the only data we have. We wish we didn't have them.
The intel the six powers collectively agreed to be terrifying to exploit. Achieved exactly once in 12,000 years.
Eight exist. One is natural. Seven show signs of engineering. The Vael refuse to elaborate.
Its transit window is a matter of timing; its destination is a matter of prayer.
The wound left behind by a cosmic explosion—or something far worse that didn't make the history books.
A 40,000-year-old structured broadcast. It's not a song. It's navigational infrastructure. But for who?
It is not empty. The things inside know you are there. It is larger on the inside.
A gravitational oscillation from something impossibly huge. The Vael have been measuring it for 30,000 years.
They don't deviate for obstacles. Obstacles deviate for them.
You remember things that didn't happen to you. The Mycel know why, and they are terrified.
Twelve thousand years old. The standard cheat code for an agonizingly vast universe.
The Dreshkai's second-largest revenue stream. Physics monetized to the maximum.
Merging flesh and metal until neither substrate remembers what it used to be.
The ultimate biological cheat code: turning your mind into software.
Replicating the Prior's tech will instantly break the galactic balance of power. Everyone is trying; everyone is terrified.
The most philosophically contested tech. Did you arrive, or just a copy of you?
The Ossian Hegemony has a classified weapons program for this. Try not to think about it.
The oldest nodes are digging up memories that predate all current civilizations.
Commerce is a weapon. They own the networks, they set the rates, they own you.
Militarily directed, hierarchically organized, spectacularly productive in the art of killing.
They don't need Capital Ships. They are the Capital Ships. They know what's coming.
The ultimate archivists. They pay premium rates for uncertainty reduction.
Access is a right. Dispersed, decentralized, and utterly impossible to govern.
Their terraforming is irreversible. They are the galaxy's memory, running on spores.
They modified the galactic core, left behind stable wormholes, and vanished. Or did they?
The face the network shows you while it eats the soil beneath your feet.
They aren't just observing the Resonance. They are designed to interact with it.
The oldest observatory in the galaxy. What exactly was it built to watch for?
The Vael's unshared archive. The Sorn couldn't steal it; the Dreshkai couldn't buy it.
"We are not the first ones here, and we are not the last ones coming."
Kills ideas before they breathe

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Established the first systematic approach to trauma, treating the body as a structure to be repaired through observation and craft.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Separated medicine from religion; argued that epilepsy was a natural Brain-Glitch, not a divine curse.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Dominated medical thought so completely that for 1,000 years, no one dared to Dissect-the-Truth to see if his pig-based anatomy books matched the body.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Introduced Clinical-Trials and recognised that Bacteria-Punks could travel through air and water.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: The birth of modern anatomy. Insisted the doctor must be the Observer, not just a reader of dusty books.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Father of Toxicology. Moved medicine from Balancing-Humors to Targeted-Chemistry.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Used math to prove the heart pumps more blood in an hour than the body weighs; blood is recycled, not consumed.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Father of Microbiology. Revealed the invisible enemies hidden from human eyes since the beginning.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Birth of Immunology. A Weak-Enemy can train the Immune-Army to defeat a Lethal-Monster.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: The Semmelweis Reflex. Mocked for suggesting doctors were killing patients. He found the truth but lacked the Lore-of-Bacteria to explain it.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Mother of Nursing & Statistics. The Healing-Environment (Light, Air, Clean) is as powerful as any chemical ally.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Applied Pasteur's Germ Theory to surgery. Proved Rot (Sepsis) is an invasion from the outside.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Realized Kind-Medicine leads to better Healing-Stats than Aggressive-Trauma-Treatment.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Birth of Anesthesia. Turned surgery from a 3-Minute-Sprint-of-Horror into a Precise-Technical-Art.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Moved surgery from Barber-Shop-Craft to Academic-Science via Comparative-Anatomy.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Established the Halstedian-Principles: gentle tissue handling, perfect hemostasis, absolute Arena-Sterility.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Father of Chemotherapy. Proved Chemistry can be a Sniper-Rifle instead of a Shotgun.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Found the Secret-Weapon nature used to fight its own Micro-Wars, bringing it to the human arena.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Turned a Lethal-Waste-Match into a Chronic-Match. Sold the patent for $1 to ensure every wrestler got the key.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Birth of the modern pharmaceutical industry. A stable mass-producible Chemical-Ally for the common man.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Refused to patent it, calling it a Gift to Humanity. Opened the era of Diagnostic-Inference.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Created Petites Curies (Mobile X-ray units) for WWI, bringing Shadow-Catching to the front lines.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Transformed imaging from a Flat-Picture into a Volumetric-Map. Created the Donut of Truth.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Magnetic Resonance Imaging. Figured out how to turn Magnetic-Signals into Pictures-of-the-Mind.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Father of Genetics. Heredity is not a Blending-of-Blood, but a Shuffle-of-Information-Packets.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Found the Physical-Storage of the Source-Code. Unlocked the language of the A, T, C, G wrestlers.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Made Genetic-Testing fast and cheap. Allows us to find a Single-Virus-Punk in an ocean of blood.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Era of Programmable-Medicine. We can now Edit-the-Wrestler to fix the Source-Code-Errors of the past.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Father of Epidemiology. Disease-Matches are won by Mapping-the-Data and Removing-the-Source.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Could you patent the sun? Prioritized Global-Arena-Safety over personal Token-Profit.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Father of Emergency Medicine. Invented Triage, treating the Most-Injured first, regardless of rank or side.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Cleaned the Arena-Environment, proving public health is about controlling the environment as much as the patient.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Proved the Body-Arena is modular. We can Swap-the-Parts to continue the Match-of-Life.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Unlocked the Secret-of-Conception, giving the Gift-of-Life to those whose natural arenas were closed.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Bridged Ancient-Wisdom and Modern-Science, proving past Arena-Secrets are still powerful.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Turned the body into a Vaccine-Factory. Hacked Protein-Translation to win the Pandemic-Brawl.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: The bridge between Medieval-Theology and Rational-Clinical-Observation, treating the Whole-Human.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Combined Mystical-Vision with Practical-Botany, keeping the Flame-of-Knowledge alive in monasteries.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: First to Stitch-the-Inside with dissolving Catgut, allowing for Deep-Arena-Repairs.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: The Prophet-of-the-Infection. Guessed the Match-Rules of contagion centuries early.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Standardized medical education, moving it into the University-and-Lab away from Apprentice-Guesswork.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: The Global-Safety-Net. Ensures Health-Stats are tracked and Vaccine-Shields delivered globally.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: He who studies without patients does not go to sea at all. The creator of modern clinical rounds.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Proved humanity must exist even in combat chaos. Turned Medical-Mercy into Global-Law.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Allowed us to hear the Internal-Soundtrack of the heart and lungs for the first time.

deckTitle: History of Medicine: The Ancestral Arena
lore: Birth of Electrocardiography. Gave the Electrical-Ghost of the heart a physical body we could study.

deckTitle: MedKayfab Elemental Wrestling: The Atomic Arena
lore: K-rich diets + Kidney stalls = Lethal Reset-Current; Calcium is the shield to protect the heart-wires.
Externalized PS is a macrophage eat me signal. Statins reduce cholesterol synthesis, altering membrane lipid composition and signaling.
Digitalis inhibits Na⁺/K⁺-ATPase → intracellular Na⁺ rises → Ca²⁺ extrusion via NCX drops → cardiac contractility increases.
Cholera toxin ADP-ribosylates Gsα, locking it in the GTP-bound active state → massive cAMP → CFTR activation → fatal secretory diarrhoea.
Constitutive activation of the RAS/MAPK cascade via KRAS mutations renders colorectal tumors completely resistant to anti-EGFR therapies like cetuximab.
Corticosteroids block this by upregulating IκBα transcription and directly transrepressing p65. Bortezomib kills myeloma cells by blocking IκB proteasomal degradation.
Amino acids (especially leucine) recruit mTORC1 to the lysosomal surface. Rapamycin targets this complex to induce profound immunosuppression.
APC is the gatekeeper of colorectal cancer. Truncated APC fails to degrade β-catenin, driving the relentless adenoma-carcinoma sequence.
PTCH1 loss-of-function drives Basal Cell Carcinoma (BCC). Vismodegib shrinks these tumors dramatically by directly inhibiting the downstream SMO.
NOTCH1 activating mutations drive >60% of T-ALL. γ-secretase inhibitors failed as Alzheimer's drugs due to extreme GI toxicity from goblet cell metaplasia.
VHL mutation stabilizes HIF-1α regardless of oxygen, creating a highly vascular pseudo-hypoxic state in clear cell Renal Cell Carcinoma.
PFK-1 is the rate-limiting step. ¹⁸F-FDG PET imaging exploits the Warburg effect by trapping phosphorylated glucose analogue (FDG-6-P) inside voracious tumors.
Thiamine (B1) deficiency halts α-KG dehydrogenase. Giving IV glucose without thiamine to an alcoholic precipitates fatal Wernicke's encephalopathy.
Cyanide halts Complex IV (cytochrome oxidase) by binding Fe³⁺. Treat with hydroxocobalamin and amyl nitrite to induce methaemoglobin as a cyanide decoy.
PDH deficiency causes severe lactic acidosis. A ketogenic diet bypasses PDH by supplying brain energy via β-hydroxybutyrate.
MCAD deficiency prevents medium-chain fat oxidation. Fasting triggers lethal hypoketotic hypoglycaemia because alternative fuels cannot be synthesized.
The liver produces ketones but lacks SCOT to use them. In DKA, high NADH from alcohol oxidation increases BHB, masking ketones on a standard urine dipstick.
Von Gierke disease (G6Pase deficiency) traps glucose in the liver, causing fasting hypoglycaemia, lactic acidosis, and a doll-like facies.
Metformin inhibits ETC Complex I, impairing the mitochondrial malate-aspartate shuttle and starving PEPCK of oxaloacetate, thus lowering fasting glucose.
Fatty acid synthesis strictly requires NADPH, linking it dependently to the pentose phosphate pathway and malic enzyme.
Statins competitively inhibit HMG-CoA reductase. This paradoxically lowers blood cholesterol primarily by triggering SREBP to upregulate hepatic LDL receptor clearance.
Hyperammonaemia drives glutamine accumulation in astrocytes, causing massive osmotic cerebral oedema. Treat CPS-I deficiency with arginine.
PKU (PAH deficiency) causes phenylalanine to cross the BBB, competitively inhibiting dopamine and serotonin synthesis, causing intellectual disability and hypopigmentation.
In Acute Intermittent Porphyria, CYP inducers (barbiturates, phenytoin) accelerate ALAS1, causing neurotoxic PBG buildup. Never give phenytoin for AIP seizures.
Lesch-Nyhan syndrome (absent HGPRT) forces purine degradation to uric acid, causing gout, and simultaneously destroys basal ganglia dopaminergic neurons causing self-mutilation.
B12 deficiency causes a functional folate deficiency (megaloblastic anaemia) PLUS methylmalonate accumulation that demyelinates the dorsal columns and corticospinal tracts.
Midgut carcinoid tumors rarely cause systemic carcinoid syndrome until they metastasize to the liver, bypassing hepatic MAO clearance.
G6PD deficiency depletes NADPH. Oxidative stress (primaquine, fava beans) oxidizes hemoglobin into Heinz bodies, which splenic macrophages bite out, causing haemolytic anaemia.
Tay-Sachs (HEXA deficiency) causes GM2 ganglioside accumulation in CNS neurons, presenting as a cherry-red spot at the macula and fatal neurodegeneration.
Fluoroquinolones (ciprofloxacin) are bactericidal because they inhibit bacterial topoisomerase II (DNA gyrase), preventing the relaxation of supercoiling ahead of the replication fork.
Lynch syndrome is caused by germline mismatch repair (MMR) gene mutations, causing microsatellite instability (MSI) and massive colorectal/endometrial cancer risk.
Alpha-amanitin from the death cap mushroom specifically blocks the elongating Ser2-P form of RNAPII, causing irreversible, delayed hepatocyte death.
Aminoglycosides bind the 30S subunit causing misreading and bactericidal death, whereas macrolides bind the 50S exit tunnel causing bacteriostatic arrest. Diphtheria toxin halts eukaryotic eEF2.
CDK4/6 inhibitors (palbociclib) force a G1 arrest in ER+ breast cancer by preventing pRb phosphorylation, restoring the gatekeeper function.
MDM2 is an E3 ligase that constantly degrades p53. Hotspot mutations in the p53 DNA-binding domain exert dominant-negative oncogenic effects.
Taxanes (paclitaxel) stabilize microtubules preventing depolymerization, while vinca alkaloids prevent polymerization. Both abnormally alter tension, permanently arresting the cell in M-phase.
PINK1 and Parkin mediate mitophagy of depolarized mitochondria. Mutations in these fail to clear toxic mitochondria, causing autosomal recessive Parkinson's disease.
PROTAC drugs are bifunctional molecules that artificially drag undruggable target proteins to an E3 ligase, hijacking Uri to destroy them.
IDH1/2 neomorphic mutations produce 2-hydroxyglutarate (an oncometabolite) that competitively inhibits TET2, causing DNA hypermethylation and a leukaemic differentiation block.
The ceRNA hypothesis states that long non-coding RNAs act as sponges, soaking up miRNAs to derepress target oncogenes. miR-21 is a ubiquitous oncomiR.
TERT promoter mutations (creating de novo ETS binding sites) are the most common non-coding mutations in cancer (melanoma, GBM), granting replicative immortality.
Multiple Myeloma cells survive at the brink of ER stress due to massive IgG secretion. Bortezomib pushes them over the edge into terminal UPR apoptosis.
In I-cell disease (GlcNAc-1-phosphotransferase deficiency), the M6P tag is never added. Hydrolases are secreted into blood instead, causing multi-system lysosomal storage failure.
MELAS (m.3243A>G) impairs mitochondrial tRNAs, starving the brain of ATP and causing stroke-like episodes in non-vascular distributions, strictly via maternal inheritance.
Mutations in tissue-specific intermediate filaments cause distinct diseases: Keratin (epidermolysis bullosa), Desmin (cardiomyopathy), and Lamin A (Progeria/rapid aging).
X-linked Adrenoleukodystrophy (ABCD1 mutation) traps VLCFAs outside the peroxisome, causing toxic accumulation that destroys the adrenal cortex and cerebral myelin.
Primary Ciliary Dyskinesia (dynein arm mutation) halts embryonic leftward nodal flow, meaning situs inversus occurs randomly in exactly 50% of patients.
Classic galactosaemia (GALT deficiency) causes neonatal liver failure, cataracts, and a highly specific vulnerability to fatal E. coli sepsis due to impaired neutrophil killing.
Serum ceruloplasmin is LOW in Wilson's disease because without ATP7B to load copper, unstable apoceruloplasmin is secreted and rapidly degraded in blood.
Propionic and Methylmalonic acidaemias cause profound hyperammonaemia because toxic propionyl-CoA directly inhibits CPS-I in the urea cycle.
PMM2-CDG (Type Ia) presents with ataxia, coagulopathy, and inverted nipples. Underglycosylation of transferrin (type I peak on IEF) is the definitive screening diagnostic.
Cancer cells are not just anaerobic; MYC and HIF-1α rewire metabolism to actively use aerobic glycolysis and glutamine for massive biomass generation.
Ferroptosis is a distinct, non-apoptotic cell death driven by lipid peroxides. It is triggered when GSH is depleted and GPx4 fails, requiring Fenton-reaction iron.
Parkinson's disease spreads via the prion-like misfolding of α-synuclein into Lewy bodies. CHIP normally links chaperones to the proteasome to prevent this.
No shortcut to pattern recognition is permitted — explain the mechanism. Case 1: Fasting hypoglycaemia = MCAD. Case 2: OCP + Rifampicin = AIP. Case 3: Myeloma + Bortezomib = Terminal UPR ER Stress.
Visceral adiposity triggers FFA release and ceramide accumulation, causing IRS-1 serine phosphorylation that fundamentally breaks the PI3K/Akt insulin signaling pathway.
The facts are real. The biology is flawless. The delivery is anarchy. Now go sabotage the boards. HUMBUG!

Dopamine tonically inhibits prolactin. Metoclopramide blocks dopamine → galactorrhea.
Acromegaly causes insulin resistance. Diagnose with high IGF-1 and failure to suppress.
Large non-functioning adenoma compresses the stalk, causing secondary hypopituitarism — all axes fail together.
Stalk compression blocks dopamine → mild prolactin rise. Treat macroprolactinoma with dopamine agonists (cabergoline).
Drives cortisol with circadian rhythm losing its pulse under stress. Interpret ACTH levels to locate the lesion.
Central DI lacks ADH (treat with desmopressin). Nephrogenic DI resists ADH (treat with low-salt diet/thiazides).
IGF falls in malnutrition even if GH is high (GH resistance). Somatostatin analogues suppress GH, reducing IGF-1.
Pregnancy increases TBG → total T4 rises, but free T4 is normal. Do not adjust dose based on total T4!
Exogenous steroids suppress the HPA axis. Abrupt withdrawal during infection causes fatal adrenal crisis.
Use stimulation tests (Synacthen) for suspected deficiency. Use suppression tests (DST, OGTT) for suspected excess.
Iodine loads temporarily shut down synthesis (Wolff-Chaikoff). Amiodarone: 37% iodine by weight, causes both hypo- and hyperthyroidism.
Severe hypothyroidism causes myxoedema (non-pitting oedema); check delayed relaxation of ankle reflexes.
Exophthalmos persists even after thyroid treatment because orbital fibroblasts have their own TSH-R. Treat with selenium.
Papillary cancer (80%) spreads via lymph nodes. Follicular cancer (15%) spreads via blood.
You MUST give PTU before Lugol’s iodine, or the iodine load will flood out as new hormone.
Absorption is impaired by food, iron, calcium. Dose must increase 15-50% immediately upon pregnancy confirmation!
Primary hyperparathyroidism is the most common outpatient cause of hypercalcaemia. Diagnosed often incidentally.
Zona Glomerulosa makes Aldosterone (driven by RAAS, NOT ACTH). Fasciculata makes Cortisol. Reticularis makes Androgens.
Sarcoidosis macrophages have 1α-hydroxylase activity, causing unregulated active calcitriol and hypercalcaemia.
Primary hyperaldosteronism (Conn’s) causes hypertension + hypokalaemia with suppressed renin.
Screen with 24h urinary free cortisol, late-night salivary cortisol, or low-dose dexamethasone suppression test.
Secondary adrenal insufficiency has LOW ACTH, therefore NO hyperpigmentation. The tan is the diagnostic clue.
Never give beta-blockers without alpha-blockade first; unopposed alpha causes lethal paradoxical hypertension!
Unilateral source = laparoscopic surgery. Bilateral source = medical management with spironolactone.
Classic salt-wasting causes neonatal crisis. Non-classic mimics PCOS in adults. Diagnose with elevated 17-OHP.
MEN2B = Medullary Thyroid Cancer, Phaeochromocytoma, Mucosal Neuromas, NO parathyroid.
Do NOT wait for lab results. Give 100mg IV hydrocortisone + large volume 0.9% NaCl immediately for unexplained hypotensive shock.
You MUST exclude phaeochromocytoma via plasma metanephrines before attempting any adrenal biopsy, or risk a fatal hypertensive crisis.
Endogenous insulin = high C-peptide. Surreptitious exogenous insulin injection = undetectable C-peptide.
Glucagon rescue injections fail in alcoholics or prolonged starvation because hepatic glycogen stores are already depleted.
DKA occurs readily in T1D because zero residual insulin means unopposed lipolysis. T2D rarely develops DKA due to residual insulin.
Metformin is first line. Add GLP-1 RA if established ASCVD, Heart Failure independent of glucose.
Hold metformin 48h for iodinated contrast; contrast-induced AKI causes drug accumulation, leading to rare but fatal lactic acidosis.
Unmatched for weight loss and cardiovascular MACE reduction, but causes dose-dependent GI nausea and delays gastric emptying.
Euglycaemic DKA (ketones high, glucose normal) and genital thrush are class effects. Watch for Fournier’s gangrene.
Produces less effect than GLP-1 RAs because it only prevents degradation of physiological levels, rather than providing pharmacological super-doses.
Avoid renally cleared glibenclamide in the elderly; metabolites accumulate causing prolonged, dangerous hypoglycaemia.
Total body potassium is depleted despite presenting hyperkalaemia. Insulin drives K⁺ back into cells; you MUST add KCl to IV fluids!
Replace fluids slowly (0.9% NaCl) to avoid cerebral oedema. Do NOT start insulin immediately unless glucose fails to fall with fluids alone. LMWH is essential!
Recurrent hypos cause Hypoglycaemia Unawareness — autonomic failure where the threshold drops and warning symptoms are lost.
Endogenous hyperinsulinism shows High Insulin + High C-Peptide + Low beta-hydroxybutyrate (insulin suppresses ketogenesis).
Glucose control prevents microvascular disease, but macrovascular protection requires high-intensity Statins, ACEI, and SGLT2I/GLP-1 RAs.
Loss of pain sensation (neuropathy) + repeated micro-trauma = painless foot ulcers and the radiologically destroyed Charcot joint.
Map every decision to its pharmacological, physiological, or anatomical basis. No gestalt. Every answer needs a mechanism.
Denosumab stops osteoclasts, but stopping it causes massive rebound fractures. Never stop without transitioning to a bisphosphonate!
Rheumatoid arthritis causes periarticular erosion via RANKL; anti-TNF biologics and Denosumab block this exact destruction pathway.
Primary hyperparathyroidism = High PTH, High Ca. Malignancy = Low PTH, High Ca, High PTHrP. Treat severe with 3-4L 0.9% NaCl + IV Zoledronate.
Hypomagnesaemia impairs PTH release AND action. Refractory hypocalcaemia will not fix with calcium alone; you must check and replace Mg!
Prolonged parathyroid stimulation becomes autonomous ('Tertiary'), causing high PTH even after a renal transplant!
Massively enlarged skull bone compresses the 8th cranial nerve, causing hearing loss. Treat with IV Zoledronate.
Correcting sodium too fast (>8-10 mmol/L/24h) causes Osmotic Demyelination Syndrome (locked-in syndrome). Restrict fluids.
Central DI responds to desmopressin. Nephrogenic (Lithium) does not. Paradoxically, thiazide diuretics reduce urine output in Nephrogenic DI!
Follicular carcinoma is impossible to diagnose on FNA; you need whole histology to see capsular/vascular invasion!
MEN1 gastrinomas are multicentric. Stop PPIs before testing fasting gastrin, as PPIs artificially elevate it in everyone!
Name the diagnosis, explain the mechanism, complete the investigation, and prescribe the treatment. Gestalt is dead.
Draw your own damn disease! If you can map the mechanism to a visual metaphor, you will never forget it on the wards. Stay fluffy!
Triggers Bradykinin (Cough). Watch for Angio-Edema-Annie & hyperkalemia.
Targeted at vessels, not the heart. Causes Edema-Eddie (swollen ankles).

King of Code-Blue. Can cause Engine-Overheat (ischemia).

Cuts the Vagus-Brake. Mad as a Hatter, Dry as a Bone.

Takes the volume load off. Do NOT use with Viagra!
Prevention only! Triggers a riot if started during an acute attack.
Acute treatment. Toxicity limit marked by Diarrhoea-Don.
Heavy artillery. Watch for Hemorrhagic-Holly (bloody bladder)—give Mesna!
Kills Liver-Larry and the Bone-Marrow-Bank.

Recognizes PAMPs (microbes, e.g., flagellin via TLR5) and DAMPs (sterile danger signals). Triggers NF-kB signaling to initiate pro-inflammatory cytokine production.
Arrives first via IL-8. Uses NADPH oxidase to make superoxide (HOCl). CGD patients lack this enzyme, suffering recurrent catalase-positive infections.
M1 (IFN-γ-activated): kills pathogens with ROS, M2 (IL-4/IL-13-activated): promotes healing and fibrosis. Presents antigens on MHC II to CD4+ T cells.
The most powerful APC. Can uniquely present exogenous viral antigens on MHC I to prime naive CD8+ T cells in the lymph node.
Kills virally infected or tumor cells that downregulate MHC I to hide from T cells. Uses perforin/granzyme. Performs ADCC via CD16.
Classical, Lectin, and Alternative pathways converge on C3b opsonization and C5b-9 (MAC lysis). Regulated by CD55 (DAF) and CD59.
The alarm signals. C3a strongly attracts neutrophils and triggers mast cells. In sepsis, massive C5a causes simultaneous inflammation and neutrophil immunosuppression.
Triggered by viral nucleic acids. Signals via JAK-STAT to upregulate PKR (blocks viral translation) and increase MHC I expression on adjacent cells.
Vasodilation (histamine) → Permeability (bradykinin) → Diapedesis (selectins/integrins). Resolves via IL-10/TGF-β or progresses to chronic fibrosis.
Built by macrophages + Th1 cells (IFN-γ) when acute clearance fails. Anti-TNF therapy (infliximab) destroys the wall, risking fatal reactivation of latent Tb.
Signal 1 = TCR + MHC. Signal 2 = Co-stimulation (CD28 + CD80/86). Without Signal 2, the T cell enters anergy (permanent shutdown).
Fights intracellular pathogens. Secretes IFN-γ to supercharge macrophages and upregulate MHC II. Drives delayed-type hypersensitivity and autoimmune tissue damage.
Driven by IL-4. Secretes IL-4 (IgE class switch), IL-5 (eosinophil activation), and IL-13. The primary driver of Type I hypersensitivity (allergy/asthma).
Suppresses immunity via IL-10, TGF-β, and CTLA-4 contact. FoxP3 mutation causes IPEX syndrome (lethal multi-organ autoimmunity in infant boys).
AID enzyme alters heavy chains. T-cell help (CD40L) is required for memory and switching. BTK mutation causes X-linked agammaglobulinemia (no mature B cells).
IgM (pentamer, immediate complement activator), IgG (most abundant, crosses placenta), IgA (dimer, mucosal), IgE (mast cell bound, allergies).
Recognizes antigens on MHC I. Kills via perforin (pores) + granzyme B (apoptosis). PD-1/PD-L1 checkpoint exhaustion in tumors.
Lower activation threshold, larger clone size, and tissue-resident persistence (TRM cells). Basis of vaccine immunity and the germinal center reaction.
IL-8: neutrophil by NLRP3 inflammasome. IL-6 drives CRP in liver, elevated in COVID-19. TNF-α drives cachexia and sepsis. Suppressed by IL-10.
Uncontrolled IL-6, IFN-γ, macrophage amplification. In primary HLH, missing lymphocyte perforin prevents CTLs from shutting off the loop.
I: Immediate IgE. II: Antibody-mediated surface cytotoxicity. III: Soluble immune complex depositing in tissues. IV: Delayed cell-activated (48-72h).
Allergen cross-links IgE on mast cells. Preformed histamine causes immediate vasodilation/bronchoconstriction. Epinephrine 1:1000 IM is the only first-line rescue (reverses shock via α1/β1/β2).
Antibodies attack specific cell surfaces. Causes Goodpasture's (anti-GBM), Autoimmune Hemolytic Anemia, and Myasthenia Gravis (receptor blockade without direct lysis).
IgG complexes form in blood during antigen excess. They deposit in small vessels (glomeruli, synovium) = complement activation + neutrophil destruction (e.g., SLE, Serum Sickness).
Cell-mediated, no antibodies! CD4+ Th1 cells recognize antigen, secrete IFN-γ, and activate macrophages. Drives contact dermatitis, tuberculin skin test, and Type 1 Diabetes.
Epithelial defect → Th2 dominance (IL-4/IL-5/IL-13). Allergen immunotherapy desensitizes by shifting the response from Th2 to Treg and inducing IgG4 blocking antibodies.
Activation releases preformed histamine (minutes). Newly synthesized leukotrienes (hours later) cause bronchoconstriction 1000x more potent than histamine. Blocked by montelukast.
Releases Major Basic Protein (MBP) to kill helminths. Driven by IL-5 (Blocked therapeutically by mepolizumab). Causes tissue remodeling in asthma and Hypereosinophilic Syndrome.
Defective apoptotic cell clearance exposes nuclear antigens. TLR9/TLR7 activate Type I IFN and autoantibody production. Treat all patients with hydroxychloroquine.
Synovial inflammation drives invasive pannus formation → cartilage/bone erosion. Anti-CCP antibodies (ACPA) are highly specific. Synovial fluid is neutrophil-rich with low glucose.
Lymphocytic infiltration destroys salivary/lacrimal glands (anti-Ro/SSA, anti-La/SSB). Causes extreme xerostomia/dry eyes, and can cause Type 1 Renal Tubular Acidosis.
Endothelial injury → Raynaud's → TGF-β driven fibrosis. Diffuse (anti-Scl-70, early ILD) vs. Limited (anti-centromere). Renal crisis MUST be treated with ACE inhibitors despite AKI.
Polymyositis: CD8+ CTLs destroy muscle expressing aberrant MHC I. Dermatomyositis: Type I IFN drives microangiopathy (Gottron's papules, heliotrope rash). Anti-Jo-1 = antisynthetase syndrome.
Large (Giant Cell Arteritis = blindness risk, immediate steroids). Medium (PAN, Kawasaki). Small (ANCA-associated: GPA/Wegener's = PR3; MPA = MPO).
HLA-B27 misfolding triggers the IL-23/IL-17 axis. Causes AS, Psoriatic, Reactive (can't see, pee, climb a tree), and IBD-arthritis. Sacroiliitis and enthesitis are hallmarks.
Hashimoto's: Th1-mediated destruction → hypothyroidism. Graves' IgG mimics TSH, continually activating the receptor → hyperthyroidism and proptosis (orbital fibroblasts express TSH-R).
CD8+ T cell-mediated destruction of beta cells. Anti-GAD65/IA-2 are markers, not the pathogenic drivers. Teplizumab (anti-CD3) can delay clinical onset in high-risk patients.
IgG antibodies directly attack the GBM/alveolar membrane. Causes pulmonary hemorrhage + Rapidly Progressive GN. Immunofluorescence shows smooth, LINEAR IgG deposition.
Complete failure of T-cell development (and often B/NK cells). Fatal if given live vaccines (e.g., BCG-fatal). Maternal T-cells crossing the placenta can cause fatal GVHD in the infant.
Pro-B fails to transition to pre-B. No mature B cells, no tonsils, no germinal centers. Highly susceptible to encapsulated bacteria (pneumococcus, H. influenzae) after maternal IgG fades at 6 months.

Normal B-cell numbers but defective antibody production (low IgG/IgA). Paradoxically presents with recurrent sinopulmonary infections, severe autoimmunity (cytopenias), and highly increased lymphoma risk.
MAC deficiency (C5-C9) specifically predisposes to meningococcal/gonococcal infections. C1-INH deficiency causes bradykinin-driven hereditary angioedema (unresponsive to epinephrine).
Hyperacute rejection is driven by preformed donor-specific antibodies (prevented by crossmatching). GVHD occurs when donor T-cells attack recipient tissues (skin, gut, liver).
Bind cyclophilin/FKBP12 → inhibit calcineurin → block NFAT dephosphorylation → prevent IL-2 transcription. Highly nephrotoxic (afferent arteriolar constriction).
Binds FKBP12 to inhibit mTOR. Blocks IL-2-driven T-cell proliferation (not production). Non-nephrotoxic. Impairs wound healing, used post-transplant and for CAR-[T].
Inhibits inosine monophosphate dehydrogenase (IMPDH). Selectively starves T and B cells, which uniquely rely entirely on de novo purine synthesis and lack a salvage pathway. Teratogenic.
Blocks TNF-α signaling. Highly effective for RA and IBD. Because TNF maintains granulomas, blockade risks fatal reactivation of latent TB. (Etanercept is a decoy receptor, fails in IBD).
Anti-CTLA-4 (Ipilimumab) and anti-PD-1 (pembrolizumab) remove inhibitory brakes on T-cells to fight tumors. Causes severe immune-related adverse events (irAEs) like colitis and pneumonitis.
Blocks intracellular JAK-STAT signaling, silencing dozens of cytokine signals simultaneously. Causes high risk of Varicella Zoster (shingles) reactivation—check immunity before starting.
IL-17 (from Th17) drives psoriasis and ankylosing spondylitis (axSpA). Anti-IL-17A is effective in skin/joints but worsens Inflammatory Bowel Disease because IL-17 is protective in the GI mucosa.
Apoptosis is clean. Necrosis is inflammatory. Coagulative necrosis (ischemia) leaves ghost outlines. Liquefactive necrosis (brain/abscesses) causes enzymatic self-digestion.
Death that shouts. Pyroptosis: inflammasome → caspase-1 → IL-1β release via gasdermin pores. Gain-of-function NLRP3 mutations cause CAPS (treat with anakinra).
Persistent TGF-β signaling activates Smad2/3 → fibroblast-to-myofibroblast transition → excessive architectural collagen (e.g., IPF, Cirrhosis). Pirfenidone blocks this pathway.
Hallmarks include immune evasion, replicative immortality, and the Warburg effect (aerobic glycolysis). Tumors actively recruit M2 macrophages and Tregs to suppress the local immune response.
The ultimate quest: Every drug, mechanism, and pathology card interacts. If you give Anti-TNF to a RA patient, you disable Granny Granuloma. If you lack BTK, you lose Barb B-Cell.

Anti-TNF (Infliximab/Adalimumab): TNF-α → RA, Crohn's, Psoriasis | Reactivates TB. JAK Inhibitor (Tofacitinib): JAK-STAT → RA, UC | Shingles (VZV) Reactivation. Anti-IL-17 (Secukinumab): IL-17A → Ankylosing Spondylitis | Worsens IBD. Anti-IL-4Rα (Dupilumab): Th2 Axis → Asthma, Atopic Derm | Eosinophilia (transient).
